name: Sara Drake
source:
Brought up rough in the city streets and alleys, this tough kid with no future sells her curvaceous young body as her only asset, until meeting Trevor. Will you save her soul? Or use your power over her and make this poor kid your sex toy?

[b]LIKES[/b]: easy money, taste of luxury
[b]HATES[/b]: violence, drugs and police
[b]DREAMS ABOUT[/b]: finding family and normal life
[b]SEXUAL PARTNERS[/b]: excessive number
